arxiv-2102-07732.title: Information leak and incompatibility of physical context: A modified approach
arxiv-2102-07732.creator: Arindam Mitra 1,2, Gautam Sharma 1,2, Sibasish Ghosh 1,2
arxiv-2102-07732.description: Abstract A beautiful idea about the incompatibility of Physical Context(IPC) was introduced in [Phys. Rev. A 102, 050201(R) (2020)]. Here, a context is defined as a set of a quantum state and two sharp rank-one measurements, and the incompatibility of physical context is defined as the leakage of information while implementing those two measurements successively in that quantum state.

arxiv-2203-14068.title: Nonequilibrium dynamics in a spin valve with noncollinear magnetization
arxiv-2203-14068.creator: Rudolf Smorka, Pavel Baláž, Michael Thoss, Martin Žonda
arxiv-2203-14068.description: Abstract We utilize a hybrid quantum-classical equation of motion approach to investigate the spin dynamics and spin-transfer torque in a spin valve under bias voltage. We show that the interplay between localized classical magnetic moments and conduction electrons induces a complex effective exchange coupling between the magnetic layers.

arxiv-2205-12910.title: NaturalProver : Grounded Mathematical Proof Generation with Language Models
arxiv-2205-12910.creator: Sean Welleck, Jiacheng Liu, Ximing Lu, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Yejin Choi
arxiv-2205-12910.description: Abstract Theorem proving in natural mathematical language – the mixture of symbolic and natural language used by humans – plays a central role in mathematical advances and education, and tests aspects of reasoning that are core to intelligence. Yet it has remained underexplored with modern generative models.

arxiv-2311-13137.title: Double shrinkage priors for a normal mean matrix
arxiv-2311-13137.creator: Takeru Matsuda, Fumiyasu Komaki, William E. Strawderman
arxiv-2311-13137.description: Abstract We consider estimation of a normal mean matrix under the Frobenius loss. Motivated by the Efron–Morris estimator, a generalization of Stein’s prior has been recently developed, which is superharmonic and shrinks the singular values towards zero. The generalized Bayes estimator with respect to this prior is minimax and dominates the maximum likelihood estimator.

arxiv-2405-15944.title: Weighing protoplanetary discs with kinematics: physical model, method and benchmark
arxiv-2405-15944.creator: B. Veronesi, C. Longarini, G. Lodato, G. Laibe, C. Hall, S. Facchini, L. Testi
arxiv-2405-15944.description: Abstract Context. The mass of protoplanetary discs sets the amount of material available for planet formation, determines the level of coupling between gas and dust, and possibly sets gravitational instabilities. Measuring mass of discs is challenging, since it is not possible to directly detect H 2 , and CO-based estimates remain poorly constrained. Aims.

arxiv-2501-05711.title: From My View to Yours: Learning Egocentric Cues from Exocentric Video using Privileged Egocentric Supervision
arxiv-2501-05711.creator: Dominick Reilly, Manish Kumar Govind, Le Xue, Srijan Das
arxiv-2501-05711.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dominick Reilly, Manish Kumar Govind, Le Xue, Srijan Das. Vision Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse video understanding tasks. However, their viewpoint invariant training limits their ability to understand egocentric properties (e.g., human-object interactions) from exocentric video observations. This limitation is critical for applications such as Activities of Daily Living (ADL) monitoring, where understanding egocentric properties is essential yet egocentric cameras are impractical to deploy, making it impossible to simply collect egocentric data at test time.

arxiv-2505-15835.title: Transforming Decoder-Only Transformers for Accurate WiFi-Telemetry Based Indoor Localization
arxiv-2505-15835.creator: Nayan Sanjay Bhatia, Katia Obraczka
arxiv-2505-15835.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nayan Sanjay Bhatia, Katia Obraczka. Wireless Fidelity (WiFi) based indoor positioning is a widely researched area for determining the position of devices within a wireless network. Accurate indoor location has numerous applications, such as asset tracking and indoor navigation. Despite advances in WiFi localization techniques- in particular approaches that leverage WiFi telemetry- their adoption in practice remains limited due to several factors including environmental changes that cause signal fading, multipath effects, interference, which, in turn, impact positioning accuracy.

arxiv-2506-00939.title: Inheritance of intracellular viral RNA in a multiscale model of hepatitis C infection
arxiv-2506-00939.creator: Tyler Cassidy, Giulia Belluccini, Sarafa A. Iyaniwura, Ruy M. Ribeiro, Alan S. Perelson
arxiv-2506-00939.description: Abstract 1 School of Mathematics, University of Leeds, Leeds, LS2 9JT, United Kingdom. 2 Theoretical Biology and Biophysics, Theoretical Division, Los Alamos National Laboratory, Los Alamos, NM 87545, USA. 3 Vaccine and Infectious Disease Division, Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, Seattle, WA, USA. Abstract Multiscale mathematical models of hepatitis C infection have been instrumental in our understanding of direct acting antivirals.

arxiv-2506-14585.title: The Effect of Photometric Errors on the Measured Width of the Main Sequence in Star Clusters
arxiv-2506-14585.creator: Steven R. Spangler
arxiv-2506-14585.description: Abstract This paper deals with the effect of errors in the B and V magnitudes, or measurements in any other color system, on the width of the main sequence in a color-magnitude (Hertzsprung-Russell) diagram. The width is defined as the dispersion in apparent (or absolute) magnitude at a fixed, measured photometric color.

arxiv-2512-13514.title: Reinforcement Learning based 6-DoF Maneuvers for Microgravity Intravehicular Docking: A Simulation Study with Int-Ball2 in ISS-JEM
arxiv-2512-13514.creator: Aman Arora, Matteo El-Hariry, Miguel Olivares-Mendez
arxiv-2512-13514.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aman Arora, Matteo El-Hariry, Miguel Olivares-Mendez. Autonomous free-flyers play a critical role in intravehicular tasks aboard the International Space Station (ISS), where their precise docking under sensing noise, small actuation mismatches, and environmental variability remains a nontrivial challenge. This work presents a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) docking of JAXA’s Int-Ball2 robot inside a high-fidelity Isaac Sim model of the Japanese Experiment Module (JEM).

arxiv-2601-03732.title: Scalar vacuum densities on Beltrami pseudosphere
arxiv-2601-03732.creator: T. A. Petrosyan
arxiv-2601-03732.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by T. A. Petrosyan. We investigate the combined effects of spatial curvature and topology on the properties of the vacuum state for a charged scalar field localized on the (2+1)-dimensional Beltrami pseudosphere, assuming that the field obeys quasiperiodicity condition with constant phase. As important local characteristics of the vacuum state the vacuum expectation values (VEVs) of the field squared and energy-momentum tensor are evaluated.

europmc-pmc8016467.title: DeepPurpose: a deep learning library for drug-target interaction prediction.
europmc-pmc8016467.creator: Huang K, Fu T, Glass LM, Zitnik M, Xiao C, Sun J.
europmc-pmc8016467.description: Summary Accurate prediction of drug-target interactions (DTI) is crucial for drug discovery. Recently, deep learning (DL) models for show promising performance for DTI prediction. However, these models can be difficult to use for both computer scientists entering the biomedical

pmc-10526328.title: Bispecific Antibodies in Hematological Malignancies: A Scoping Review
pmc-10526328.creator: Mohamed H Omer, Areez Shafqat, Omar Ahmad, Khaled Alkattan, Ahmed Yaqinuddin, Moussab Damlaj, Umberto Vitolo
pmc-10526328.description: Simple SummaryBispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs) and bispecific antibodies (BiAbs) have emerged as novel therapeutic modalities in the treatment of advanced hematological malignancies. BiTEs and BiAbs redirect T cells to attack tumors and facilitate T-cell-mediated cell death. Blinatumomab was the first BiTE to display proof-of-concept with its remarkable contribution towards the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

pmc-11529980.title: Circulating proteins linked to apoptosis processes and fast development of end-stage kidney disease in diabetes
pmc-11529980.creator: Katsuhito Ihara, Eiichiro Satake, Parker C Wilson, Bozena Krolewski, Hiroki Kobayashi, Zaipul I Md Dom, Joseph Ricca, Jonathan Wilson, Jonathan M Dreyfuss, Monika A Niewczas, Alessandro Doria, Robert G Nelson, Marcus G Pezzolesi, Benjamin D Humphreys, Kevin Duffin, Andrzej S Krolewski
pmc-11529980.description: Many circulating proteins are associated with risk of ESKD, but their source and the biological pathways/disease processes they represent are unclear. Using OLINK proteomics platform, concentrations of 455 proteins were measured in plasma specimens obtained at baseline from 399 individuals with diabetes.

pmc-11674507.title: Machine Learning-Driven Innovations in Microfluidics
pmc-11674507.creator: Jinseok Park, Yang Woo Kim, Hee-Jae Jeon
pmc-11674507.description: Microfluidic devices have revolutionized biosensing by enabling precise manipulation of minute fluid volumes across diverse applications. This review investigates the incorporation of machine learning (ML) into the design, fabrication, and application of microfluidic biosensors, emphasizing how ML algorithms enhance performance by improving design accuracy, operational efficiency, and the management of complex diagnostic datasets.

pmc-11679773.title: Latvian Healthcare Professionals’ Self-Reported Knowledge, Attitudes, and Behaviors Related to Pregnancy Prevention Program Materials for Valproate-Containing Medicines
pmc-11679773.creator: Milana Špoģe, Mirdza Kursīte, Elita Poplavska
pmc-11679773.description: Background: Valproates are recognized for their significant teratogenic risks, which can lead to physical defects and developmental disorders when used during pregnancy. To mitigate these risks, the Pregnancy Prevention Program (PPP) was developed by European regulators for patients and healthcare professionals (HCPs).

pmc-12592224.title: Physiological and psychological therapeutic effects of telerehabilitation treatment on patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12592224.creator: Jinyu Zhu, Yui Kikuchi, Seiji Nishimura, Katsuyuki Shibata
pmc-12592224.description: [Purpose] Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is a progressive and fatal respiratory disease that affects older adults. Pulmonary rehabilitation improves symptoms and quality of life but faces barriers such as limited access. Telerehabilitation, enabled by technology, offers remote, personalized care and may overcome these barriers.

pmc-12683043.title: Surgical impact of pafolacianine-based intraoperative molecular imaging in lobar versus sublobar pulmonary resection
pmc-12683043.creator: Gregory T. Kennedy, Feredun S. Azari, Sonia Singhal, Lydia Chen, Viktor Gruev, Edward Delikatny, Sunil Singhal
pmc-12683043.description: lesions, and detecting synchronous malignant nodules. Examples of clinically significant events in pulmonary resections guided by pafolacianine. Central Message Intraoperative molecular imaging (IMI) with pafolacianine can improve oncologic resections by detecting positive margins, identifying occult lesions, and detecting synchronous malignant nodules. With increasing adoption of lung cancer screening, more than 1 million pulmonary nodules are detected annually.

pmc-12779438.title: A modified strategy in robot-assisted laparoscopic partial nephrectomy for localized renal tuberculosis: the “unroofing and base excision” technique and clinical outcomes
pmc-12779438.creator: Yong Ban, Zehua Ma, Di Liu, Min Xiong, Ting Yue, Lingyue An, Qingyu Zhang, Hao Liu, Chenggong Luo, Kai Li, Guangheng Luo
pmc-12779438.description: Renal tuberculosis is one of the main reasons for nephrectomy. Early removal of tuberculous lesions can preserve the remaining functional renal tissue and help avoid nephrectomy. Robotic-assisted surgery significantly improves the success rate of partial nephrectomy. The present study aims to introduce a modified robotic surgical approach, the ‘unroofing and base excision’ technique, for treating localized renal tuberculosis.

pmc-13126587.title: Self-Care Practices and Knowledge of Hypertension Management Among Patients Attending Clinics in Tanzania: A Multi Centre Analytical Cross-sectional Study
pmc-13126587.creator: Julius Edward Ntwenya, Joseph Nyanda Shilole, Edmund Boniface Bunyaga, Elihuruma Eliufoo Stephano
pmc-13126587.description: Background:Hypertension is a serious public health problem. Adherence to the recommended self-care practices (SCPs) significantly prevented hypertension and abated its undesired related health outcomes. This study assessed the SCPs, knowledge of hypertension management, and factors associated with SCPs adherence among adults attending clinics in selected hospitals in Tanzania.

pmc-13237038.title: Nuclear waste radionuclides unveil three decades of anthropogenic carbon in the Canada Basin of the Arctic Ocean
pmc-13237038.creator: Annabel Payne, Lorenza Raimondi, Anne-Marie Wefing, Christof Vockenhuber, Habacuc Pérez-Tribouillier, William Williams, Sarah Zimmermann, Núria Casacuberta
pmc-13237038.description: Ocean-atmosphere CO2 exchange is key in modulating global climate, but the Arctic Ocean’s anthropogenic carbon (Cant) uptake is poorly constrained. Most studies in the Canada Basin using the Transit Time Distribution (TTD) relied on two years of paired gas tracers, CFC-12 and SF6.

pmc-13374410.title: Associations between intimacy and health behaviours among older adults in romantic relationships: a cross-sectional survey conducted in the mid-Atlantic USA
pmc-13374410.creator: Tarya Pillay, Jennifer L Moss
pmc-13374410.description: IntroductionBeing in a romantic relationship can be associated with positive health outcomes. However, little is known about how characteristics of these relationships influence health among older adults.MethodsAdults (aged 50+ years) from seven mid-Atlantic US states completed an online survey, which included measures of emotional, intellectual and sexual intimacy from the Personal Assessment of Intimacy in Relationships Inventory.

pmc-13586790.title: Subregional Functional Connectivity of the Precuneus as a Preclinical Biomarker in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-13586790.creator: Claudia Aponte, Antonio Jimenez-Marín, Malen Razkin, John Fredy Ochoa Gómez, Asier Erramuzpe, Ibai Diez, David Aguillón-Niño, Carlos Tobón, Jesús M Cortés, Ankit Dhoundiyal
pmc-13586790.description: IntroductionThe precuneus (Pc) is a central hub integrating diverse brain functions, and it is early involved in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathophysiology, yet its subregional vulnerability remains poorly understood. This study aims to delineate the differential involvement and vulnerability of these subdivisions in the early stages of AD.
